scripts.release: bun run build && bun run publish-packages && changeset tag
scripts.publish-packages: for dir in packages/schema packages/preview packages/core packages/headless packages/canvas packages/driver-image; do (cd "$dir" && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls -t *.tgz | head -1) && npm publish "$tgz" --access public && rm -f "$tgz") || exit 1; done
scripts.verify-pack: bun run build && for dir in packages/schema packages/preview packages/core packages/headless packages/canvas packages/driver-image; do (cd "$dir" && bun pm pack && tgz=$(ls *.tgz | head -1) && echo "==> $dir ($tgz)" && tar -xOf "$tgz" package/package.json | node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const bad=[...Object.entries(d.dependencies??{}),...Object.entries(d.devDependencies??{})].filter(([,v])=>String(v).startsWith('workspace:')||String(v).startsWith('catalog:')); if(bad.length){console.error('Unresolved:',Object.fromEntries(bad)); process.exit(1)} else {console.log('deps ok:', {...d.dependencies,...d.devDependencies})}" && rm -f *.tgz); done
